Worker retains local directory and effective node/task intersection. No IO, config parser, SDK or stateful implementation in API.

pangrova-config/src/main/java/org/pangro.review: Declare one long byte-count option with default zero and explicit per-task/Worker-local policy semantics. Parsing remains in existing typed config infrastructure; invalid range is rejected by SpillBudget during assembly.
